name: freehire.me (+ Jobicy)
note: API sweep of many job sites; runs every time

name: Company career sites (employer watchlist)
note: Reads each listed company's own board; the companies are picked in the next step

name: LinkedIn
note: Job-alert emails by default; reading LinkedIn itself is opt-in and against its terms. Easy Apply is never filled

name: Hacker News "Who is hiring?"
note: One monthly thread; startups, many remote

name: Indeed
note: One national domain per country (tr.indeed.com, de.indeed.com…); mostly on-site and hybrid

name: Glassdoor
note: Discovery only; applying happens on the employer's site

name: Wellfound
note: Startup roles; browsable logged out, applying needs an account

name: Kariyer.net
note: Türkiye's national board; applying needs a Kariyer.net account

name: XING
note: DACH board; useful for relocation, not for remote

name: Djinni
note: Eastern Europe tech board; applying needs a published profile, many posts require Ukrainian

name: Dice
note: US tech board, mostly staffing contracts; needs a Dice profile
